verdict.rationale: Manufact is an MCP server hosting and gateway platform, so runtime tool discovery through meta-tools is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions tool search, lazy loading, or meta-tools that let an agent find and load tools on demand. Its official MCP server exposes platform management functions as ordinary MCP tools, which is a different capability and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
